title: Why Bitclub Network ??
description: Short video is showing CLUBRICH Co-Founder explaining Why Bitclub Network (English version)

asr.full_text: We at Clubrich are a group of investors who are looking for a mining opportunity and we chose BitClub Network. Let me tell you why. BitClub Network is one of the world's largest mining companies. It allows you the opportunity of mining through their facilities by purchasing a share in any one of their mining pools and earning daily profits. It inspired us very much by its vision, which is bringing wealth to the masses. Only a few companies out of those verified by the blockchain offer a mining opportunity, the rest are privately owned. This means that you can safely continue to earn bitcoins without going through the hassle of mining by yourself. Let me give you a preview about Bitclub Network. Bitclub Network was established in October 2014. It is currently rated as one of the top mining companies around the world. You can verify that yourself by visiting www.blockchain.info.t BitClub network mines some of the best performing cryptocurrencies, Bitcoins and some other altcoins. Its mining facility is located in Reykjavik, Iceland. Let me right now show you why they chose Iceland. It's a great opportunity for me to be able to work with them or work with them in a new way. They're a great tool. They're a great tool. They're a great resource. They're a great tool. They're a great resource. They're a great tool. And you're going to have a great time with your business. BitClub Network provides 100% passive income with an option to build a distribution network that channels this amazing business opportunity to individuals around the world who would like to also benefit from mining with the company. It has produced hundreds of cryptocurrency millionaires around the world. So, how do you start? Become an exclusive member with a one-time membership fee paid once in a lifetime. That's the first step. The second step is to purchase a share in one of the company's mining pools. There are several options that you can choose from. You can purchase a share in Pool 1, Pool 2, Pool 3, and best of all is to have a share in each one of these pools, and that's called a founder pool. When you purchase a share in any one of these mining pools, you get a chance to mine Bitcoins with BitClub network for a period of 1,000 days. These 1,000 days are renewable or extendable by reinvesting a portion of whatever mining earnings you receive on a daily basis. This can be done by simply adjusting your account to automatically reinvest whatever portion you choose of your daily mining earnings. That's for mining. Now, let me ask you, are you willing to earn a lot more bitcoins?

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitClub Network as a way to earn daily profits and "100% passive income" through cryptocurrency mining. It instructs viewers to become members by paying a lifetime fee and purchasing mining-pool shares, while also encouraging recruitment into a distribution network. The presentation uses unusually strong wealth claims, including that the scheme produced cryptocurrency millionaires, without providing substantiation or risk disclosure.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links paid membership and purchased mining-pool shares to recurring mining earnings. The membership fee and the pool-share purchase are distinct participation costs.
